cohort_scope: Reuse all8previously measured streams74000..74007 and all32after-tail contexts. No case, role, style, answer or baseline-correctness filtering. Exploratory mechanism diagnostic, not fresh confirmation.

source_origins.N: Normally encoded prefix, then normal complete tail using ComponentHold(none).
source_origins.H: The same normally encoded prefix, then both gates held only during the complete tail. All18recurrent matrices equal the normal prefix; convolution and KV still advance.

construction: After both tails finish, compose all8memory conditions before any question. Copy selected recurrent/conv fields and KV from independent N/H forks at the same natural positions. All12prefix KV slices must be equal, so N/H KV differences concern only the tail. Preserve complete native bookkeeping; require N/H bookkeeping equal. No tail or question recomputation after composition.
state_scope: Only cached tensors are intervened on. Every question suffix is processed normally from the fixed composed cache. This changes subsequent Query computation; it is not a direct semantic-fact readout or a proof of natural representational equivalence.
hybrid_logits: A composed cache has no claim to a corresponding last-token hidden/logit vector. Do not attach either source logits as a hybrid measurement. Cached suffix forwarding computes actual question logits anew.
question_independence: Composition accepts caches and the origin label only, never a question, role, support or answer. Each cache serves all6role/style questions under both readers.
source_control: Reconstruct every N/H complete cache and normal prefix, require exact content fingerprints/complete bookkeeping and genuine source logits against the published original run. Compare all1536old endpoint five-field readouts exactly; these replays are operational controls excluded from new-primary counts.
cache_control: Complete actual tensor inventory, all attributes, source contents/layouts/logits and storage isolation after every composition/readout. Report component equality and difference per layer; retain equivalent combinations without resampling and require identical composed caches to replay the same five readout fields.
attention_control: Observe all6actual eager Attention layers for every new cached readout and endpoint replay; zero prefill calls, positive retained-record mass, oracle suppressed probability/mass exactly0.

operational_controls.native_kernel_checks: Reuse all10native-precision checks with the immutable addendum; preserve original ideal-FP32 failure.
operational_controls.frozen_weights_and_hooks: Verify all native weights before/after, all fixed adapter bytes/freeze and removal of every installed hook/kernel wrapper.

analysis.all_cells: Report all16condition×reader cells per model (32overall), both lengths, related/unrelated tails, all roles/styles and every stream. Joint3and6, full paired gains/losses and gold NLL; keep baseline failures.
analysis.contrasts: At each fixed context compare single component changes with NNN and single component repairs with HHH, every factorial two/three-way NLL interaction, oracle/full and matched related/unrelated contexts. Related-current answers change; report those as new-value controls, separately from fixed-prefix evidence.
analysis.origins: Clearly label4608new readouts versus1536archived endpoint references and1536new endpoint operational replays. Reused-cohort causal sensitivity, not independent confirmation.
analysis.limits: Crossed states can be off distribution. State changes necessarily affect future Query/answer computation. Functional rescue does not prove a fact was stored or erased, a learned semantic update rule, or a new architecture advantage.
